assumptions.note: iVol bands rebuilt from the prior close and prior VIX close; the plain line is approximated by the straddle constant and every zone figure is marked approx.

fadeLower.label: Lower band tagged, closes back inside

fadeUpper.label: Upper band tagged, closes back inside

fadeAny.label: Either band tagged, closes back inside

fadeLowerToCenter.label: Lower band tagged, closes above the anchor

fadeUpperToCenter.label: Upper band tagged, closes below the anchor

zoneLowerFade.label: Lower zone entered, closes back above the zone (approx.)

zoneUpperFade.label: Upper zone entered, closes back below the zone (approx.)

zoneLowerHeld.label: Lower zone entered and NOT crossed intraday (approx.)

zoneUpperHeld.label: Upper zone entered and NOT crossed intraday (approx.)

breakToWeekly.label: Daily band broken at the close, weekly band reached LATER that week

breakToWeeklyWithDaysLeft.label: Same, only breaks with sessions left in the week

breakTouchedWeeklySameDay.label: DIAGNOSTIC: break day itself already touched the weekly band (not tradeable)

weeklyFadeLower.label: Weekly lower band reached, week closes back inside

weeklyFadeUpper.label: Weekly upper band reached, week closes back inside

weeklyFadeAny.label: Either weekly band reached, week closes back inside

afterLowerTagNextUp.label: After a lower tag, the NEXT session closes higher

afterUpperTagNextDown.label: After an upper tag, the NEXT session closes lower

baseNextUp.label: BASE: any session, the NEXT session closes higher

baseNextDown.label: BASE: any session, the NEXT session closes lower
